dataset.inclusion_rule: observed (complete base, C4', C3') at >= 1481 consensus positions of the aptamer core; comparisons use the 1469 positions observed in every included instance
dataset.fixed_correspondence: Rfam consensus match states observed with complete base atoms in every eligible instance, restricted to consensus 1-1533

mapping_check.result: every clustered instance has a match-state residue with coordinates at every shared position

discrepancy.label: Geometric discrepancy
discrepancy.unit: dimensionless (base-centre deviation in A and base rotation in rad, weight 1, divided by n)
discrepancy.definition: D = sqrt(L + O) / n after Kabsch superposition of the n base centres: L = sum of squared base-centre deviations, O = sum of squared base-rotation angles (FR3D standard base frames); fixed correspondence on the n shared Rfam consensus positions
discrepancy.values_layout: row-major upper triangle (i < j) in dataset.instances order; diagonal 0

cut.rule: undo the k - 1 highest merges; height midway between the lowest merge undone and the highest kept

clustering.rationale: k = 2 cuts the largest merge-height gap of the average-linkage tree (0.103 to 0.131) and has the best silhouette for k = 2-7 (0.538): 50 chains (computed head swivel -1.0 to 14.4 deg) vs the 10 most rotated chains (12.7 to 20.7 deg), the first split reported by the research (RF00177_EXPANDED_60_RESULTS.md). The tree is a continuum of head rotation with gaps of similar size (k = 3-5: 0.012-0.016) and no bootstrap or jackknife was run for the 60-chain set: provisional. The groups describe head rotation (eta^2 swivel 0.59) and agree only weakly with the curated state categories (ARI 0.04) and not with antibiotic site or publication (ARI ~0). Chosen by the user on 2026-10-17.

floor.definition: 95th percentile of the duplicate pairs (NCS copies, isomorphous re-determinations); smaller differences are not interpretable. Not shown: the research computed no duplicate-pair floor for the 60-chain run (its expanded summary reports a near-duplicate threshold, disc 0.016, which is a different quantity)

tm.label: TM-score
tm.definition: US-align TM-score with fixed residue correspondence (-mol RNA -I <pair.fasta> -u n), normalised by the n shared positions (symmetric); clustering and the dendrogram use 1 - TM-score
tm.values_layout: row-major upper triangle (i < j) in dataset.instances order; diagonal 1

cut.rule: undo the k - 1 highest merges; height midway between the lowest merge undone and the highest kept

clustering.rationale: TM-score (fixed correspondence over the 1469 shared positions) gives the same 50 / 10 split at k = 2, with the largest merge-height gap (0.034 to 0.053) and the best silhouette for k = 2-7 (0.727). No bootstrap or jackknife: provisional. Chosen by the user on 2026-10-17.

floor.definition: 95th percentile of the duplicate pairs (NCS copies, isomorphous re-determinations); smaller differences are not interpretable. Not shown: the research computed no duplicate-pair floor for the 60-chain run (its expanded summary reports a near-duplicate threshold, disc 0.016, which is a different quantity)

provenance.note: pairwise values copied from the research run; no structural comparison was recomputed
